[SWS_CM_99038] Method response message segmentation
⌈
If the attribute
SomeipMethodDeployment.maximumSegmentLengthResponse is set to a value,
and the data length is larger than maximumSegmentLengthResponse, the SOME/-
IP response message shall be transmitted/received using segmentation as de-
scribed in [PRS_SOMEIP_00720] and following.
⌋
